caseNameFull: Walter A. Ledbetter, Receiver, etc., in Error v. Kaufman Mandell
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of New York.
attorneys: Mr. Arthur F. Gotthold, Mr. Joseph W. Bailey and Mr. Walter A. Ledbetter for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Louis Marshall for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Judgment affirmed with costs by an equally divided court.
